name: cache-references
meaning: Kernel generic cache references; cache level, prefetch and request scope are CPU/kernel dependent.

name: cache-misses
meaning: Kernel generic cache misses; not guaranteed to be demand-load or LLC misses.

name: L1-dcache-loads
meaning: Kernel L1D read-access mapping; speculative versus retired scope must be checked per CPU.

name: L1-dcache-load-misses
meaning: Kernel L1D read-miss mapping; may count refills rather than retired misses.

name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_l2
meaning: Demand data fills from local L2; refill/replacement evidence, NOT stores.

name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_cache
meaning: Demand fills from local cache domain excluding local L2; not total LLC accesses or pure LLC hits.

name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_dram
meaning: Demand fills from DRAM or IO on this die; omits remote DRAM and is NOT direct LLC misses.

name: dTLB-load-misses
meaning: Kernel data-TLB read-miss mapping; may mean page walks rather than L1 TLB misses.
